# mergeah_connection (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler connection. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_connection" "example" {
  resource_id = "134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3"
}

locals {
  connection = jsondecode(data.mergeah_connection.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Agent Handler ID of the Connection.

### Optional

- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
